digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler config status map / jira_family value maps
propositions: config.local_to_jira_status is a third independent literal copy of the canonical Jira-family status map with nothing preventing it from drifting.
The third copy is currently content-identical to LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA but a mutation of its 'deleted' key left the whole suite green, proving no test guards divergence.
A parity test in test_config.py must assert full-dict equality between config.local_to_jira_status and the canonical map loaded by path via _load_attr, rather than single-sourcing via import.
core config.py must not import the jira_family adapter, since that would invert the one-way dependency direction and hide the operator-override kill-switch behind an adapter import.
A lock-step comment naming the canonical map and the enforcing test is added to config.py, mirroring the existing jira_to_local_status idiom, with no map value changes.
The parity test is mutation-checked: mutating 'deleted' to a non-workflow value fails only the new test, and reverting restores all-green.
